description: SENSITIVE WRITE — get the traveler's explicit approval of the full total and the hotel's cancellation policy first. Asks Geisel Power to place the reservation. No payment is taken: the traveler pays the hotel directly under its own terms, and hotel bookings carry no fee. Returns complete_in_progress with a confirmation deadline (within 24 hours); poll get_booking_session for the hotel's confirmation number, which is also emailed to the traveler.
name: complete_booking_session
title: Book it (requires the traveler's approval)
